findings.passage: To help protect Indiana's elections, officials will have more tools to maintain accurate and up-to-date voter registration lists. Also, proof of citizenship will be required for individuals registering with temporary IDs and first-time voters will be required to provide proof of residency.
findings.note: Text from a joint press release issued by the House caucus in the names of Reps. Payne and Engleman, under the heading 'Increasing Election Security'. It is release text, not a direct quote of Payne. It describes new 2024 laws on voter-roll upkeep, proof of citizenship for people registering with temporary IDs, and proof of residency for first-time voters. It does not name a bill number.
subjects: proof of residency for first-time voters

findings.motion: Co-author of House Bill 1317, Various election law matters (status then: first reading, referred to committee)
findings.note: WRTV lists Payne as co-author of HB 1317. As described there, the bill would require an absentee ballot applicant to write in a driver's license number or last four digits of a Social Security number, bar pre-printing those numbers on the form, and bar the Election Commission from expanding vote-by-mail. This is a news description of the bill, not the bill text.
